prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1175; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] when your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped at a traffic signal. The police report documents the impact and identifies your insured as the driver who failed to stop in time. Liability in this matter is clear.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a concussion. Immediately following the impact, our client experienced headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, follow-up visits with a neurologist, and a period of mandated cognitive rest. Our client has been unable to work full duties during recovery and continues to experience symptoms that affect daily activities. Medical records and billing statements are enclosed.

Under the circumstances, our client has sustained substantial economic losses, including medical expenses and lost income, along with significant pain, suffering, and diminished quality of life. We have calculated these damages and are prepared to resolve this claim without litigation.

Our client demands payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that time, we will file a civil complaint without further notice.
